title: Ghost inbox
description: The contract for a Ghost request file (ghost/in/<id>.json). Feed this to a local model as a response-format schema (Ollama `format`, llama.cpp JSON schema, vLLM guided_json) and the model cannot emit a malformed action. Emitting valid JSON is the one thing small models reliably struggle with, and it is the one thing a schema removes entirely.

text.description: say: what to speak in chat.

block.description: find: substring of a block id.

item.description: have/craft: a full item id, e.g. minecraft:redstone.

match.description: blockmap: substrings to bucket by, e.g. ["ae2:", "mekanism:"].

nbt.description: blockmap: also read each block entity's configuration (filters, per-face routing).

check.description: craft: plan it and report what is missing, taking nothing. Use this before any large build.

go.description: Send the body to `at` before running the action. Skip for bulk work; it only adds travel time.

cmd.description: command: a server command. Output goes to logs/latest.log, NOT the outbox.

as.description: Player name to act on behalf of, for the rank check.

dim.description: Dimension id like minecraft:overworld or allthemodium:mining. Omit for wherever the player is.

name.description: The place name, for remember/forget. REQUIRED by both - omitting it is a hard failure, not a default.

slot.description: Which slot of the container, for take/put. Defaults to 0 when absent, so leaving it out acts on the FIRST slot rather than erroring - name it.

sneak.description: Crouch while using the block. Many blocks put a second action behind a sneak-click; without this that half is unreachable.

face.description: Which face to click, for use. Defaults to up.

onlyAir.description: For fill: only place into air, leaving existing blocks alone. False overwrites - and breaks what was there.

drop.description: For clear: whether the blocks yield their items, as breaking them would.

detail.description: For entities: full per-entity rows including saved NBT, rather than counts.

type.description: For entities: only report entity ids containing this substring.

is.description: For waitFor: the block id to wait for at the given position.

idle.description: For waitFor: wait until everything nearby stops moving, for a physics event of unknown length.

timeout.description: For waitFor: ticks to wait before giving up. Defaults to 1200 (one minute).

keepPending.description: For say: leave the player's outstanding questions marked unanswered instead of clearing them.

note.description: Free text recorded with a remembered place.
